description: Tables with a fixed schema, primary and foreign keys, SQL queries and joins across tables.
A group of writes that is atomic, keeps constraints consistent, runs isolated from others and is durable once committed.
Storing each fact once and referring to it by key, so updates touch one row and reads use joins.
Copying data next to where it is read to avoid joins, at the cost of updating every copy.
Keeps JSON-like documents read and written as one unit, with a flexible shape.
Looks a value up by its key, which makes that lookup very fast; a question that does not start from the key is slow or unsupported.
Groups rows into partitions by a key and sorts them inside it, built for heavy writes read by key and range.
A query or write the application runs, with its rate; the list of them decides the database.
